title.zh-TW: `/resume` 啟動反應加速，冷快取與過期摘要快速載入長篇對話
title.en: `/resume` Startup Responsiveness Accelerated, Fast Loading for Long Conversations with Cold Caches and Stale Summaries

body.zh-TW:
接續先前討論過的大型長篇任務，恢復對話的載入反應現在敏捷許多。⟦好似老航海船長翻開厚實的航行日誌，就算前段航程的彙整摘要尚未預先抄錄、或是前次留下的備忘筆記早已過期，也能立刻翻至指定頁面接續記錄，不再被卡在漫長的翻查等待中。⟧以前在終端機輸入 `/resume` 指令嘗試開啟對話紀錄特別龐大的歷史時，只要摘要快取（把對話內容預先暫存起來以加速讀取的機制）處於尚未預熱的冷啟動狀態、或者快取內容已經過期，啟動過程往往會出現明顯的停頓延遲。現在這項啟動反應速度已獲得改善，即使面對快取尚未就緒或內容過期的長篇歷史紀錄，也能迅速完成載入並恢復對話。

```
# 接續過往對話紀錄
agy /resume
```
body.en:
Resuming large, extended tasks from previous discussions is now significantly more responsive. ⟦Like an experienced sea captain opening a thick logbook who can immediately turn to the target page and continue recording without getting stuck in a long search, even if the summary of the previous voyage has not been prepared yet or the previous memo notes have long expired.⟧ Previously, when running the `/resume` command in the terminal to open an exceptionally large conversation history, noticeable delays would occur whenever the summary cache (a mechanism that temporarily stores conversation content in advance to speed up reading) was cold or stale. This startup responsiveness has now been improved, allowing the system to quickly complete loading and resume conversations even with unready or expired caches over long conversation histories.

```
# Resume past conversation history
agy /resume
```

items.original: Improved `/resume` startup responsiveness when opening a large conversation history with a cold or stale summary cache.

title.zh-TW: 外掛隨附 MCP 伺服器自動套用命名空間，徹底防範重名衝突
title.en: Plugin-Bundled MCP Servers Automatically Namespaced to Prevent Name Collisions

body.zh-TW: 為終端機擴充各式外部工具，外掛隨附的伺服器重名衝突現在迎刃而解。當你使用 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）時，不同外掛套件隨附的伺服器，過去若恰好取了相同的名稱，彼此之間、或是與你在 `mcp_config.json` 中自訂的伺服器便會發生衝突與覆蓋。這種命名撞車會導致其中一方無法正常運作。現在系統會自動替外掛隨附的伺服器加上命名空間，統一改以 `<plugin>_<server>` 的格式獨立註冊，徹底解決重名互相覆蓋的問題。⟦恰如大型聯合辦公室替各進駐團隊編發專屬分機號碼，在內部總機名稱前自動加上團隊代號，就算不同團隊都恰巧指派了一位「總務」，各分機撥通時也絕不互相佔線或搶撥。⟧
body.en: When extending the terminal with various external tools, name collisions among plugin-bundled servers are now completely resolved. When using MCP (Model Context Protocol, a protocol for connecting AI to external tools), bundled servers across different plugins that happened to share the same name previously collided with each other or overwrote custom servers in your `mcp_config.json`. Such naming clashes would prevent one of the servers from working properly. The system now automatically namespaces plugin-bundled servers, registering them independently in the `<plugin>_<server>` format to eliminate overlapping naming conflicts. ⟦Just like a large coworking space assigning dedicated extension numbers to each resident team by prefixing team codes to internal directory names, ensuring that even if multiple teams each appoint a "general affairs" lead, calls to different extensions never interfere with or intercept each other.⟧

items.original: Fixed MCP servers bundled inside plugins colliding with each other or with user-configured servers in `mcp_config.json` when they shared the same server name by automatically namespacing plugin MCP servers as `<plugin>_<server>`.

title.zh-TW: 開啟或切換對話修復背景協程洩漏，顯著降低記憶體佔用
title.en: Opening or Switching Conversations Fixes Background Goroutine Leak, Significantly Reducing Memory Usage

body.zh-TW: 頻繁開啟歷史對話或在任務間切換，終端機不再悄悄囤積過多電腦記憶體。⟦彷彿房務人員走進客房整理床單後，卻忘記關閉浴室抽風機與走廊照明，讓馬達在無人使用的空房中持續空轉耗電，如今退房流程落實了隨手關閉機制，房間巡檢完畢便即刻切斷閒置電器。⟧以前只要在命令列開啟或掃描對話紀錄，背景負責清理步驟快取（用來暫存各執行步驟紀錄的內部機制）的背景協程常會殘留下來，並在整個工作階段中持續運行，造成不必要的記憶體流失。這個記憶體流失問題現在已經修好，執行 `/resume` 重新載入對話或在不同對話間頻繁切換後，系統記憶體佔用顯著減少，長久運作依然維持輕快。
body.en: When frequently opening conversation histories or switching between tasks, the terminal no longer silently accumulates excessive system memory. ⟦Much like housekeeping staff making beds in a guest room but forgetting to turn off the bathroom exhaust fan and hallway lights, leaving motors idling and consuming electricity in an empty room, whereas the check-out process now enforces a shutdown protocol to immediately cut power to idle appliances after room inspection.⟧ Previously, whenever conversation histories were opened or scanned from the command line, background goroutines responsible for evicting step cache (an internal mechanism for temporarily caching execution step records) often lingered and ran throughout the rest of the session, causing unnecessary memory leaks. This memory leak has now been fixed, significantly reducing system memory usage after running `/resume` or switching between conversations, keeping long-running sessions nimble and responsive.

items.original: Fixed a memory leak where opening or scanning conversations left background step-cache eviction goroutines running for the rest of the session, significantly reducing memory usage after opening `/resume` or switching conversations.

title.zh-TW: `view_file` 拒絕非 UTF-8 二進位檔與 100 MB 超大檔，防止上下文塞爆
title.en: `view_file` Rejects Non-UTF-8 Binary Files and 100 MB Oversized Files to Prevent Context Overflow

body.zh-TW: 把檔案交給 AI 閱讀時，工具現在能主動擋下會塞爆上下文視窗的非預期輸入。以前使用 `view_file` 工具查看檔案時，若遇上非 UTF-8 編碼的二進位檔案，往往會硬當成純文字解析；甚至在碰上體積大於 100 MB 的超大檔案時，也會直接嘗試塞進模型的上下文視窗（模型在單一輪對話中所能讀取與容納的文字容量上限）。這種過度載入常導致對話中斷或發生錯誤。現在這項缺陷已經修好，面對不支援的二進位格式與超大檔案，工具會在讀取前直接予以拒絕並回傳明確錯誤，避免塞爆模型上下文視窗。⟦好比自動文件掃描機的進紙托盤，遇到未支援的透明塑膠板、或是厚度超過一百頁的厚重硬皮書時，會在入紙口主動退件並亮起清楚的錯誤警示，絕不硬塞進滾輪以防卡紙扯壞內部機件。⟧
body.en: When handing files over for AI reading, the tool now actively intercepts unexpected inputs that would overflow the context window. Previously, when using `view_file` to inspect files, non-UTF-8 encoded binary files were often forcibly parsed as plain text, and files larger than 100 MB were directly loaded into the model's context window (the upper limit of text capacity that the model can ingest and hold in a single turn). Such overloading frequently led to conversation aborts or errors. This defect is now fixed; unsupported binary formats and oversized files are directly rejected with a clear error before loading, preventing context window overflows. ⟦Much like an automatic document scanner tray that actively rejects unsupported transparent plastic sheets or bulky hardcover books exceeding one hundred pages at the feeder with a clear error warning, never forcing them into the rollers to prevent paper jams and internal mechanical damage.⟧

items.original: Fixed `view_file` attempting to parse non-UTF-8 binary files as text or loading files larger than 100 MB into the model context; unsupported binary formats and oversized files are now rejected with a clear error before overflowing the context window.

title.zh-TW: Gemini API 工作階段保留前輪思考區塊，並正確傳遞思考簽章
title.en: Gemini API Sessions Retain Thinking Blocks from Prior Turns and Correctly Propagate Thought Signatures

body.zh-TW: 透過金鑰與模型展開多輪深度交談，上一輪的思考脈絡現在能完好延續。⟦恰似數學競賽選手在多輪解題時保留每一步草稿演算，並在每段推導末端加蓋防偽個人戳記，交卷時所有先前的思考手稿與印鑑都能完整夾帶遞交，不會在進入下一題時把前一題的推論過程整張撕毀。⟧以前透過 `GEMINI_API_KEY` 啟動 Gemini API 工作階段時，每當使用者送出後續的新訊息，系統往往會遺失先前對話輪次中的模型思考區塊。同時，文字段落與思考段落上的思考簽章（用來驗證推論過程完整性與身分的數位記號）也無法正常傳遞。這兩項缺陷現在皆已修正，模型的思考紀錄與簽章能在多輪對話中順暢保留並正確傳播。
body.en: When engaging in multi-turn in-depth conversations with models via API keys, the thinking context from prior turns is now cleanly preserved. ⟦Just like a math competition contestant preserving draft calculations for every step across multiple problem-solving rounds and stamping an anti-counterfeit personal seal at the end of each derivation, so that all prior thought manuscripts and seals are submitted together without tearing up earlier reasoning when moving to the next question.⟧ Previously, when launching Gemini API sessions via `GEMINI_API_KEY`, sending subsequent user messages often caused the system to drop model thinking blocks from previous conversation turns. Additionally, thought signatures (digital markers used to verify the integrity and identity of reasoning processes) on text and thought parts failed to propagate properly. Both defects have now been fixed, allowing model thinking records and signatures to be smoothly retained and correctly propagated across multiple conversation turns.

items.original: Fixed Gemini API (`GEMINI_API_KEY`) sessions dropping model thinking blocks from prior turns on subsequent user messages and failing to propagate thought signatures on text and thought parts.

title.zh-TW: 產出物審查修復父路徑比對，對話分支與快照排除系統內部目錄
title.en: Artifact Review Fixes Parent Path Matching; Conversation Forks and Snapshots Exclude Internal System Directories

body.zh-TW: 審查程式產出物或建立對話分支，專案內部目錄的管理現在更加乾淨俐落。以前若在 `.gemini/` 之上的父目錄路徑中包含 `scratch` 等被忽略的路徑名稱，產出物審查（檢視程式碼生成成果的檢查面板）常會意外失效而無法觸發。此外，在執行對話分支或快照復原時，過去常會多餘複製內部專用的 `.system_generated/subagents` 與 `.system_generated/worktrees` 資料夾，且在刪除對話時也未清理子代理人的後設資料。如今這些管理問題均已修復，分支與復原不再夾帶內部目錄，刪除對話時也會同步清除子代理人紀錄。⟦如同建築事務所封存設計專案時妥善區隔公開成果與內部暫存，分流衍生新圖紙時主動排除草稿夾裡的臨時施工模型與分身圖層，專案結案銷毀時也同步清空各協力小組的派工備忘錄。⟧
body.en: When reviewing code artifacts or branching conversations, internal project directory management is now much cleaner. Previously, if a parent directory path above `.gemini/` contained skipped path names such as `scratch`, artifact review (an inspection panel for reviewing generated code outputs) often failed to trigger. In addition, when executing conversation forks or snapshot reverts, internal `.system_generated/subagents` and `.system_generated/worktrees` directories were unnecessarily copied, and deleting conversations failed to clean up subagent metadata. These management issues have now been resolved: forks and reverts no longer include internal directories, and deleting a conversation cleanly purges subagent records. ⟦Like an architecture firm archiving design projects by properly separating public deliverables from internal temp files, actively excluding temporary construction models and duplicate draft layers when branching new blueprints, and clearing assignment memos across partner teams when closing and destroying a project.⟧

items.original: Fixed artifact review failing to trigger when a directory name above `.gemini/` matched a skipped path component such as `scratch`, prevented conversation forks and snapshot reverts from copying internal `.system_generated/subagents` and `.system_generated/worktrees` directories, and cleaned up subagent metadata records when deleting a conversation.

title.zh-TW: 修復已刪除對話在背景重新連線時誤建為空白 `SQLite` 資料庫
title.en: Fixes Deleted Conversations Recreated as Empty `SQLite` Databases on Background Reconnection

body.zh-TW: 手動清空不需要的舊對話紀錄，已經被刪除的歷史檔案絕不再死灰復燃。⟦有如銀行客戶前往櫃台辦理結清銷戶後，即使後台批次排程稍後才再次連線清查餘額，系統也絕不會因為收到查詢請求，就莫名在金庫中自動重新立起一個連帳號欄位都沒有的空白保險箱。⟧以前在使用者刪除對話紀錄之後，若有背景查詢作業嘗試重新連線，往往會在底層硬生生重新建立起一筆空白且缺乏資料結構的 `SQLite` 資料庫檔案。這些幽靈檔案不僅徒增混亂，也無法正常讀取。這個幽靈重建問題現在已經徹底修復，背景查詢重新連線時不會再擅自生成空白資料庫，刪除對話確實清爽乾淨。
body.en: When manually clearing unwanted conversation histories, deleted history files will never resurface. ⟦Like a bank customer closing an account at the counter, where even if backend batch schedules reconnect later to check balances, the system never automatically erects an empty safe in the vault lacking even account fields just because an inquiry request was received.⟧ Previously, after a user deleted conversation histories, any background queries attempting to reconnect would recreate empty, schema-less `SQLite` database files underneath. These ghost files added clutter and could not be read properly. This ghost recreation bug has now been completely resolved; background queries reconnecting after deletion no longer generate empty databases, keeping conversation deletions truly clean.

items.original: Fixed deleted conversations being recreated as empty, schema-less SQLite database files when background queries reconnected after deletion.

title.zh-TW: 無工作區對話維持獨立隔離，不再意外繼承其他工作階段自訂路徑
title.en: Workspaceless Conversations Maintain Strict Isolation, No Longer Inheriting Custom Paths from Other Sessions

body.zh-TW: 不在任何專案目錄下隨手開啟終端機，獨立交談環境現在具備完善的隔離邊界。以前在未指定工作區資料夾的狀態下啟動新對話，該工作階段往往會意外繼承其他正在運行的開啟工作階段中的專案路徑與自訂設定。這種跨工作階段的設定滲漏，容易導致臨時對話誤讀了無關專案的客製化規則或檔案目錄。這個隔離缺陷現在已經修好，未指定工作區的對話會維持純粹獨立，不再擅自套用其他工作階段的環境路徑與自訂設定。⟦這好比走進共享空間租用一張臨時空桌，桌面上乾淨清空，既不會莫名翻出隔壁專案工作室遺留的門禁磁卡與私人物料，也不會意外套用其他租客專屬的自訂燈光偏好。⟧
body.en: When launching the terminal outside of any project directory, standalone conversation environments now maintain proper isolation boundaries. Previously, when starting a new conversation without a workspace folder, the session often inadvertently inherited project paths and customizations from other open sessions running concurrently. This cross-session leak caused ad-hoc conversations to mistakenly read irrelevant project rules or file directories. This isolation defect has now been fixed: conversations launched without a workspace folder remain purely standalone, no longer inheriting environment paths and custom settings from other sessions. ⟦Much like renting a temporary hot desk in a shared workspace with a clean, clear surface, where you neither uncover access keycards and personal materials left behind by adjacent project studios nor inadvertently adopt another tenant's custom lighting preferences.⟧

items.original: Fixed conversations launched without a workspace folder inheriting workspace paths and customizations from other open sessions.

entries: **The Windows panel opens inside the screen at high display scaling** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). pywebview 6.2.1 returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them as scale 1.0, while `move()` / `resize()` multiply their input by the window's DPI again. At 250% on 3840x2160 the default x came out as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved, so every relaunch repeated it. Screen rectangles are now converted to logical pixels with the window's own DPI (only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, so a future pywebview that fixes this is not double-converted), and `window.show()` is queued behind the placement so the panel never appears at a stale position.

**The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

**The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

**The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

**Installed status line and session resume hooks are replaced with the current copies.** Both scripts had changed without a version bump — the status line's `1000k` fix and ten session-resume fixes since July — so existing installs kept the old files. The status line goes to `1.6` and session resume to `1.7`, and a new test keeps the session-resume script version and installer constant in step.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板在高縮放螢幕不再貼邊，重開位置精準
title.en: Windows panel no longer clings to screen edge at high scaling, reopening accurately

body.zh-TW: 使用 3840x2160 高解析度螢幕並開啟 250% 縮放時，Windows 面板現在會準確開在畫面之內。⟦這好比木工師傅照著設計圖施工，助手卻誤把圖面上的公尺當成公分再放大換算，讓做好的櫃子直接卡死在牆角。⟧底層套件 `pywebview 6.2.1` 回傳的螢幕範圍明明是實體像素，卻標記成縮放 1.0。後續 `move()` 與 `resize()` 又拿視窗自身 DPI 重複相乘，使得預設水平坐標被算成 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448，將面板釘在右下角邊緣，且該位置還被存檔讓每次重開都重演。現在程式只在主螢幕回報 1.0 且視窗 DPI 不是 96 時，才用視窗自己的 DPI 將螢幕矩形換算回邏輯像素，避免未來 `pywebview` 修好時重複換算；同時將 `window.show()` 排在擺位之後，面板絕不再閃現在舊位置。
body.en: When using a 3840x2160 high-resolution display with 250% scaling, the Windows panel now opens accurately within the screen bounds. ⟦This is like a carpenter building according to blueprints, but an assistant mistakes meters for centimeters and scales them up again, leaving the finished cabinet wedged tightly against the wall corner.⟧ The underlying package `pywebview 6.2.1` returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them with a scale of 1.0. Subsequent `move()` and `resize()` operations then multiplied their inputs by the window's own DPI again, causing the default horizontal coordinate to be calculated as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved so every relaunch repeated the issue. Now the program converts screen rectangles back to logical pixels using the window's own DPI only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, preventing double conversion if a future `pywebview` release fixes this; at the same time, `window.show()` is queued after placement, ensuring the panel never flashes at a stale position.

items.original: **The Windows panel opens inside the screen at high display scaling** ([#130](https://github.com/aqua5230/usage/issues/130)). pywebview 6.2.1 returns screen bounds in physical pixels but labels them as scale 1.0, while `move()` / `resize()` multiply their input by the window's DPI again. At 250% on 3840x2160 the default x came out as 3840 − 380 − 12 = 3448, pinning the panel to the bottom-right edge, and that position was saved, so every relaunch repeated it. Screen rectangles are now converted to logical pixels with the window's own DPI (only when the primary screen reports 1.0 while the window DPI is not 96, so a future pywebview that fixes this is not double-converted), and `window.show()` is queued behind the placement so the panel never appears at a stale position.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板支援混合縮放多螢幕，重開精準回到原螢幕
title.en: Windows panel supports mixed-scaling multi-monitor setups, reopening precisely on the original display

body.zh-TW: 外接不同螢幕工作的讀者，若各螢幕設定了不同的縮放比例，關閉 Windows 面板後重新開啟，它現在會老實回到當初關閉的那台螢幕。先前系統儲存面板位置時，是把實體像素除以視窗當下所在螢幕的 DPI；這導致在 225% 縮放螢幕上關閉的面板，重新開啟時卻莫名其妙彈回 100% 的主螢幕。新版改為直接儲存實體像素，等到擺放面板位置時，才搭配視窗當下的 DPI 進行換算。⟦這如同在不同比例尺的地圖之間穿梭，標記位置時若除以當前圖紙比例，重新翻開時便會走樣跳回起點；改存真實公尺距離後，在哪張地圖合上就在哪張地圖展開。⟧這項改進完全不改變偏好設定的鍵名與資料格式。
body.en: For users working with external monitors configured with different scale factors, closing the Windows panel and reopening it now reliably returns it to the specific display where it was closed. Previously, the system saved the panel's position by dividing physical pixels by the DPI of whichever display the window was currently on; as a result, a panel closed on a 225% scaling display would unexpectedly jump back to the 100% primary screen upon reopening. The new version saves positions directly in physical pixels and only converts them using the window's current DPI when placing the panel. ⟦This is like navigating between maps of different scales: if marked locations are divided by the current sheet's ratio, reopening them distorts the coordinates back to the starting point; storing the actual meter distances instead ensures that whichever map you close on is where you reopen.⟧ This improvement leaves preference key names and data formats completely unchanged.

items.original: **The Windows panel reopens on the display it was closed on with mixed scaling.** The saved position was physical pixels divided by the DPI of whichever monitor the window was on at that moment, so a panel closed on a 225% display reopened on the 100% primary. Positions are now saved in physical pixels and converted with the window's current DPI when placed. The preference key and shape are unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板放寬矮螢幕縮放下限，按鈕與狀態列不再裁切
title.en: Windows panel relaxes zoom floor on short displays, preventing buttons and status row from being cut off

body.zh-TW: 把 Windows 面板開在偏矮的螢幕上時，若曾碰過重新整理或結束按鈕被切出畫面外的窘境，現在這類版面裁切問題已徹底解決。⟦這彷彿在低矮的天花板下擺放展示架，若硬性規定層架間隔不能縮小，最底層的控制旋鈕就會被地面擋住；按空間比例動態調降底線，底部按鍵才不被擠出視野。⟧過去面板設有 0.6 的縮放下限，卻未考慮視窗自身的 DPI，使得 2560x1440 搭配 225% 縮放時，面板被卡在比實際需要更大的縮放比例，導致速率與狀態列以及重新整理和結束按鈕全部掉出畫面之外。現在 Windows 將縮放下限改為 `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`，確保文字顯示依然絕不小於 100% 螢幕的 0.6 倍，同時讓整張面板順利塞進螢幕內；macOS 則維持原樣不變。
body.en: When opening the Windows panel on shorter screens, any issues where the Refresh or Quit buttons were cut off outside the viewport are now completely resolved. ⟦This is like placing a display rack under a low ceiling: if shelf spacing is rigidly forbidden from shrinking, the bottom control knobs get blocked by the floor; dynamically lowering the floor based on available space keeps bottom buttons from being squeezed out of view.⟧ Previously, the panel enforced a 0.6 zoom floor without accounting for the window's own DPI, causing the panel at 2560x1440 with 225% scaling to remain stuck above the zoom level it actually needed, which pushed the rate and status row as well as the Refresh and Quit buttons entirely off-screen. Windows now changes the zoom floor to `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale`, ensuring text rendering is still never smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display while allowing the entire panel to fit smoothly inside the screen; macOS remains unchanged.

items.original: **The bottom of the Windows panel is no longer cut off on short high-DPI screens.** The 0.6 zoom floor did not account for the window's DPI, so at 2560x1440 @225% the panel was held above the zoom it needed and lost its rate/status row and Refresh/Quit buttons. Windows now uses `MIN_PANEL_SCALE / window DPI scale` as the floor, so text still never renders smaller than 0.6× of a 100% display; macOS is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 系統匣提示限制字數，避免例外吞沒導致面板停更
title.en: Windows tray tooltip enforces character limit, preventing swallowed exceptions from stalling panel updates

body.zh-TW: 開啟 Windows 系統匣觀察各家 AI 用量，開著的面板現在絕不會無聲無息地停止更新。先前新增了 Grok 欄位之後，在英文介面且每家提供商額度皆滿 100% 的極端狀況下，提示文字長度會達到 129 個字元；這讓底層圖示套件 `pystray` 拋出 `ValueError: string too long` 錯誤，但該錯誤卻被背景工作常駐程式 `_refresh_worker()` 默默吞掉，連同該輪更新畫面的 `inject_state()` 也一併跳過，導致面板看似開著卻再也不會刷新數據。現在系統匣提示文字強制限制在 127 個字元以內，徹底防範字串過長引發的崩潰。⟦這種脫節宛如展場跑馬燈因文字過長當機，值班警衛不但沒回報還順手切斷訊號線，讓大廳螢幕默默停在上一輪舊畫面。⟧
body.en: When opening the Windows tray to check AI usage across providers, an open panel will no longer silently stop updating. Previously, after adding the Grok row, tooltip text reached 129 characters in the extreme case of an English interface with every provider's quota at 100%; this caused the underlying icon library `pystray` to raise a `ValueError: string too long` error, which was silently swallowed by the background worker `_refresh_worker()`, skipping that cycle's UI update `inject_state()` as well and leaving the open panel unable to refresh data. The tray tooltip text is now strictly capped at 127 characters, completely preventing crashes caused by excessively long strings. ⟦This disconnection is like an exhibition marquee crashing from text that is too long, and instead of reporting it, the duty guard casually disconnects the signal cable, leaving the lobby display quietly frozen on the previous frame.⟧

items.original: **The Windows tray tooltip is capped at 127 characters.** Since the Grok row was added, the English tooltip with every provider at 100% reached 129 characters; pystray raised `ValueError: string too long`, which `_refresh_worker()` swallowed along with the same iteration's `inject_state()`, so an open panel silently stopped updating.

title.zh-TW: 終端機狀態列與接續提醒自動換新，補齊修復並校準版號
title.en: Terminal status line and session resume hooks update automatically, incorporating fixes and aligning version numbers

body.zh-TW: 先前已在電腦中安裝過狀態列與工作階段接續提醒的使用者，現在升級時會自動替換成最新版腳本。過去這兩支 hook（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）雖然歷經多次修改，涵蓋狀態列進位的 `1000k` 修正以及 7 月以來工作階段接續提醒的十項修正，卻因為未調升版號，讓既有安裝一直留在舊檔案。新版將狀態列升級至 1.6 版、接續提醒升級至 1.7 版，安裝程式會主動用最新副本覆蓋舊檔，並新增自動化測試確保腳本版號與安裝常數隨時步調一致。⟦這恰似圖書館借閱處更新了服務規章，封皮上的版本代號卻漏未換新，讓館員誤以為抽屜裡積滿灰塵的舊手冊仍是現行規定。⟧
body.en: Users who previously installed the status line and session resume hooks on their systems will now have them automatically replaced with the latest script versions upon upgrading. In the past, although both hooks underwent numerous modifications—including the status line rounding fix for `1000k` and ten fixes to session resume since July—the lack of version bumps left existing installations stuck on older files. The new release bumps the status line to version 1.6 and session resume to 1.7, with the installer actively overwriting old files with the latest copies and adding an automated test to ensure script version numbers and installer constants stay strictly in step. ⟦This is just like a library circulation desk updating its service policies but forgetting to update the version code on the cover, leading librarians to mistakenly believe the dusty manual in the drawer is still the active rulebook.⟧

items.original: **Installed status line and session resume hooks are replaced with the current copies.** Both scripts had changed without a version bump — the status line's `1000k` fix and ten session-resume fixes since July — so existing installs kept the old files. The status line goes to `1.6` and session resume to `1.7`, and a new test keeps the session-resume script version and installer constant in step.

## Experimental: Route GitHub API traffic through a custom host

Organizations can now route a GitHub host's API traffic through a gateway using the new per-host `api_host` configuration:

```shell
# Route API traffic for github.com through a gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Read the configured API host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

The original host remains in use for authentication, Git remotes, and browser URLs.

> [!NOTE]
> `api_host` is experimental and is not a security boundary. Requests may still reach the original host.

title.zh-TW: GitHub API 流量支援自訂閘道，身分驗證與網址維持直連
title.en: GitHub API Traffic Supports Custom Gateways, While Authentication and URLs Remain Direct

body.zh-TW:
企業若需要稽核或集中管控網路流量，現在可以透過個別主機的 `api_host` 設定，將 GitHub API 請求導向自訂閘道（gateway，把流量轉去另一個位址再送出的中繼點）。這項改動只會轉發 API 呼叫，登入身分驗證、Git 遠端儲存庫操作與瀏覽器開啟網址仍會直接連線至原始主機。此功能目前仍處於實驗階段，且不是安全邊界，部分請求可能依然會送往原始主機。

```
# 設定將 github.com 的 API 流量轉發至自訂閘道
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# 查詢特定主機目前設定的 API 閘道位址
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦這就像公司設立的公務收發室，員工採購與查詢資料等業務公文統一由專屬窗口轉交處理，但員工出勤打卡、私人包裹寄送與親自拜訪仍直接走大樓正門。⟧
body.en:
Organizations that need to audit or centrally manage network traffic can now route GitHub API requests to a custom gateway via the per-host `api_host` setting. This change only forwards API calls; login authentication, Git remote repository operations, and browser-opened URLs still connect directly to the original host. This feature is currently experimental and is not a security boundary, so some requests may still reach the original host.

```
# Set up forwarding API traffic for github.com to a custom gateway
gh config set api_host gh-gateway.example.com --host github.com

# Query the currently configured API gateway address for a specific host
gh config get api_host --host github.com
```

⟦This is like a company mailroom for official business, where business documents such as procurement requests and data inquiries are routed through a dedicated counter, while employee clock-ins, personal parcel deliveries, and in-person visits still go directly through the building's main entrance.⟧
